About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Vice President serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Vice President plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

This role creates thought leading advice, strategies, tactics for Analyst Relations Leaders through published insight, conversations with client (Inquiry), stage presentations, teleconferences, and client meetings. It is important that you have a vision for how Analyst Relations programs can maximize their impact, through a balanced program that addresses inbound and outbound needs serving worldwide and regional interests.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in an Analyst Relations team or leadership role

  • Working with Senior Leadership in marketing, communications, strategy, or product areas to drive corporate direction / achieve corporate goals

  • Planning, developing and executing an evaluative & advisory AR program

  • Deploying tools and technologies to support the strategic execution and operational layers of the analyst relations function to deliver on objectives

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Aven Hospitality is an innovative technology provider powered by SynXis®, the leading global hospitality commerce and distribution platform. We empower hoteliers around the world to exceed expectations, solve daily challenges, and stay ahead of the competition.

With our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, hoteliers can manage distribution, retailing, payments, operations, and more. Providing hoteliers the tools to maximize revenue, improve operational efficiency, and deliver personalized guest experiences that drive satisfaction.

Our tools are built to seamlessly integrate with each hotelier’s unique strategy, elevating guest satisfaction and creating meaningful connections.

We are pioneering AI in hospitality technology to unlock new opportunities, drive efficiency, and personalize the guest experience. By prioritizing stability, scalability, and data-driven insights, we equip hoteliers to adapt and thrive in an ever-changing landscape, ready for whatever comes next..

Corporate Strategy Analyst

THE TEAM

The Corporate Strategy team shapes the company’s long-term direction, connects strategy with execution, and actively drives the initiatives that grow the business. We work on the company’s most important strategic questions: from long term business planning and board-level decisions to product strategy and new growth programs. We partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Technology, Commercial, Finance, and Operations to turn those decisions into results.

This role provides significant exposure to senior leaders, functional heads and VPS.The role offers an early-career professional a rare opportunity to develop broad business, strategy, and leadership skills in a high-growth, Private Equity-backed technology company.

WHY JOIN US

This role is designed for someone who is self-driven, takes ownership of their work, and wants to learn the industryquickly. Here is what you can expect:

  • Work on real strategic priorities, not side projects. You will own workstreams and produce outputs that directly inform the most important executive decisions for Aven.

  • Exposure to senior leadership. You will regularly interact with functional heads across the business, building relationships and visibility that accelerate career growth.

  • A fully remote, high-autonomy environment. We trust people to manage their own time and deliver results. If you thrive with ownership and minimal hand-holding, you will fit in.

  • Broad scope, fast learning curve. Strategy, product, commercial, and operations - you will develop fluency across multiple domains in a compressed timeframe.

  • PE-backed growth context. The company is executing an ambitious long-range plan targeting significant revenue and EBITDA growth. You will be part of that exciting journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Corporate Strategy Analyst is a core member of the Corporate Strategy team, reporting to the Director of Corporate Strategy. The role spans twomain areas of work: (i) corporate strategy and long-range plan support, (ii) product strategy. It is an ideal fit for an early-career professional with a consulting foundation who wants meaningful work, broad exposure, and the experienceof driving their own projects.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Corporate Strategy and Long-Range Planning

  • Support the development and execution of long-term strategic plans and enterprise-wide innovation roadmaps that align with Aven's business objectives and growth strategy.

  • Work with cross-functional leaders to identify emerging opportunities, evaluate market trends, and design initiatives that advance the company's long-termgrowth plan.

  • Develop business cases, strategic frameworks, and operating models to guide future investments and organizational priorities.

  • Design strategic planning sessions for business leaders to define future-state capabilities, priorities, and execution frameworks.

  • Translate complex business challenges into actionable strategic recommendations that enable sustainable growth and competitive advantage.

  • Apply working knowledge of financial conceptsto support strategic discussions: unit economics, margin contribution, revenue drivers.

  • Prepare board presentations, executive materials, and decision-support documents for senior leadership.

  • Establish methodologies, governance frameworks, and planning processes to support enterprise innovation and long-term business planning.

  • Support the launch and execution of business initiatives across functional teams

2. Product Strategy

  • Evaluate future business opportunities, technology investments, and operational improvements to determine potential impact and return on investment.

  • Develop strategic planning sessions for business leaders to define future-state capabilities, priorities, and execution frameworks.

  • Produce structured analyses to help product and executive leaders evaluate growth paths,tradeoffs and investment options.

  • Assess product performance and how the portfolio is evolving relative to market opportunity.

  • Support leadership and internal stakeholder teams to identifyannual priorities and align them to corporate and commercial strategy.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree is not required.

  • 2-3 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a comparable analytical role.

  • Consulting firm background or similar;

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to produce executive-ready content.

  • Strong proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, or similar) as productivity and analytical aids.

  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems and develop clear, data-driven recommendations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to independently produce executive-level presentations.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams with limited oversight and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience at a management consulting firm (tier-one or tier-two).

  • Exposure to SaaS, technology, hospitality, travel, or marketplace businesses.

  • Familiarity with product strategy, portfolio management, or competitive intelligence.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES / COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic thinking and structured problem-solving

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Intellectual curiosity and a growth mindset

  • Effective collaboration and stakeholder management

  • High autonomy and ownership: comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment

CORE BEHAVIOR EXPECTATIONS

Successful employees at Aven consistently demonstrate behaviors aligned to the Aven A’s:

  • Ambition – Taking initiative, raising the bar, and striving for better outcomes.

  • Action – Turning ideas into results and driving work forward.

  • Acumen – Applying sound judgment, curiosity, and business understanding to make informed decisions.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation

  • Generous Paid Time Off (25 PTO days)

  • 8 hours of Volunteer Time Off (VTO)

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and wellness program

  • 12 weeks paid parental leave

  • Fully remote work — work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Formal and informal reward, recognition, and acknowledgement programs

WORKING ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Fully remote position — U.S.-based

  • Minimal travel expected; occasional travel for leadership offsites or company events.

  • No physical requirements beyond standard office/computer work

Reasonable Accommodation

Aven Hospitality is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. Applicants applying for a Aven Hospitality position with a disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact Aven Hospitality at Contact Us

Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

Affirmative Action

Aven Hospitality is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to minorities, females, veterans and disabled individuals. EEO IS THE LAW

Risepoint is an education technology company that provides world-class support and trusted expertise to more than 100 universities and colleges. We primarily work with regional universities, helping them develop and grow their high-ROI, workforce-focused online degree programs in critical areas such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. Risepoint is dedicated to increasing access to affordable education so that more students, especially working adults, can improve their careers and meet employer and community needs.

The Impact You Will

Make Marketing and Operations Strategy is a pivotal team within our company, operating under the COO (Chief Operating Officer) organization. As the internal consulting arm for both marketing and operations teams, the team’s mission is to identify, prioritize, and drive critical cross-functional projects aimed at tackling the company’s highest priority opportunities. This team will be a key enabler to drive revenue generation and operations excellence.

The Senior Analyst, Marketing and Operations Strategy will play a crucial role in shaping the team’s success. Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing and Operations Strategy, this individual will collaborate closely with senior leaders across marketing and operations to scope and deliver key priority projects aligned with organizational goals and KPIs.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Hypothesis generation: Conduct in-depth exploratory analyses and benchmarking to identify growth opportunities. This may include process audits, evaluations of tools and technologies, assessing go-to-market (GTM) strategies, conducting financial analysis, and performing external benchmarking
  • Project planning and execution: Define, structure, and execute operational initiatives by developing work plans, gathering and synthesizing relevant data, leading analyses, and developing actionable recommendations
  • Stakeholder alignment: Build strong partnerships with stakeholders within marketing and operations, as well as with other functions; drive alignment on key priorities across this diverse stakeholder set
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Drive collaboration with cross-functional partners across the organization to deliver on projects
  • Storytelling: Synthesize key insights, recommendations, and action items in a clear, concise, and coherent way; create executive-level materials and presentations to drive buy-in and alignment
  • Scaling best practices: Identify and scale best practices and innovations, including forming a deep understanding of products, processes, systems/tools, personnel, and strategic direction

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers rigorous, data-backed analyses and recommendations that senior leaders trust and act on
  • Independently scopes and drives complex cross-functional initiatives from diagnosis through implementation, with minimal oversight
  • Is viewed as a go-to thought partner across marketing and operations, building strong relationships and driving alignment among diverse stakeholders
  • Produces clear, executive-ready materials that accelerate decision-making and secure buy-in
  • Surfaces opportunity areas that translate into measurable revenue growth or operational efficiency

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Number, quality, and business impact of strategic initiatives delivered (e.g., revenue generated, cost savings, efficiency gains)
  • On-time delivery of project workplans and key milestones
  • Adoption and scaling of recommendations and process improvements by stakeholder teams
  • Measurable improvement in the marketing and operations KPIs tied to the projects led
  • Feedback from senior leaders and cross-functional partners on quality, collaboration, and impact

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, or a related field
  • 2-3 years of professional experience, including experience in growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, and/or product strategy in a consumer-focused industry
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex projects, building appropriate processes and tools, and delivering results
  • Strong analytical skills – ability to extract, prepare, and analyze large datasets to identify patterns and insights
  • Strong conceptual problem-solving skills – ability to break down complex problems in a structured manner and go beyond first-level insights to identify the root cause
  • Strong project management and implementation skills – ability to create detailed workplans, manage cross-functional partners, and drive complex projects from conception to implementation
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations
  • A self-starter who is analytical and results-oriented
  • Ability to work well in a matrix environment across multiple groups and levels, managing change and prioritizing across multiple projects Experience That’s Great to Have
  • Experience working in client services such as consulting or banking
  • Experience in the OPM or Higher Education sectors

Who We Are
Imagine the opportunity to work with some of today’s top pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies. Imagine a career where every day brings something new, something different, something challenging. This is what it’s like to work at Sedulo Group.

Sedulo Group (www.sedulogroup.com), named one of Consulting Magazine’s Best Firms to Work For and recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest growing privately held consulting firms in America, is a thought leader in the integration of competitive strategy, competitive intelligence, and market research.

We are a competitive strategy consultancy that works on behalf of our clients to understand their competitive environment and outmaneuver their competition. Our work shapes strategy at the highest levels of the life sciences industry and, by extension, positively impacts patients’ lives.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst to join our Life Sciences practice. Analysts are the foundation of our project teams, conducting research, synthesizing findings, and producing client-ready deliverables that directly inform the decisions of global pharmaceutical and biotech leaders.

This role offers an opportunity to deepen expertise in competitive intelligence while gaining exposure to strategic advisory work. It is ideal for candidates with prior consulting experience who want to apply their skills in a focused life sciences and strategy context.

Analysts at Sedulo grow not only by tracking competitor activity but also by helping frame the “so what,” the strategic implications that shape client decision-making.

What You’ll Do
  • Support project teams in delivering on Sedulo’s Life Sciences client engagements.
  • Conduct secondary research using open-source and subscription databases.
  • Perform primary research by engaging with industry experts and stakeholders to understand market trends, competitive positioning, and strategic implications.
  • Track and analyze competitor drug pipelines, clinical trial progress, regulatory milestones, and launch activity.
  • Monitor commercial activity, including promotional strategies, earnings calls, pricing, and adoption trends.
  • Build and maintain Excel trackers and dashboards, and develop client-ready reports and presentations in PowerPoint.
  • Collaborate with managers and directors to surface the strategic insights and implications behind the data.
  • Ensure all deliverables meet Sedulo’s high standards of accuracy, clarity, and polish.

Our Ideal Candidate
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences discipline (Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology)
  • Advanced degrees a plus but not required.
Experience
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in life sciences competitive intelligence, consulting, market insights, or related fields (internships considered).
  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical therapeutic areas and indications, and an understanding of how scientific, clinical, and commercial factors intersect to shape business strategy.
  • Familiarity with drug pipeline and clinical trial data highly valued.
Skills & Attributes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to distill complex data into clear insights.
  • High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to produce polished, client-ready outputs.
  • Keen business acumen and intellectual curiosity about science, markets, and strategy.
  • Attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work; you hold yourself to the highest standard.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and take initiative with minimal oversight.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive base salary
  • Performance-based bonusComprehensive benefits package (health, vision, dental, life and disability, 401k with match, PTO, holidays, and professional development)
  • Remote position with opportunities to travel occasionally for team meetings, medical conferences, and industry events

Why Sedulo?
At Sedulo, you will:
  • Work on high-impact projects for top-tier life sciences clients.
  • Gain exposure to both competitive intelligence and strategic consulting.
  • Join a firm recognized for growth, excellence, and culture.
  • Be part of a team that values initiative, quality, and intellectual rigor.

This is a UK-based remote role. You will be required to interview in person.

About SailPoint

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security, turning complex enterprise protection into a massive business enabler. Consistently recognized as a global enterprise leader by top industry analysts and named a Gartner Peer Insights Customers Choice, our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of the workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities.


Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform eliminates security blind spots and transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic competitive advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.


About the Role

As a Deal Strategy Analyst (Deal Advisor), you will act as a pivotal strategist and tactician supporting our EMEA sales organization. You will serve as the central point of contact for sales representatives, sales leadership, legal/contracts, and finance to structure, review, and approve standard and complex commercial transactions. In this role, you will advise sales teams on pricing strategies, margins, discounting guardrails, and non-standard terms, while ensuring operational efficiency and governance across all quotes generated in Salesforce CPQ.


About the Team

You will join a high-performing EMEA Deal Desk team distributed across the UK and mainland Europe. The team operates as an internal center of excellence and trusted advisory partner to sales leadership, guiding deals from opportunity development to signature. We foster a collaborative, supportive environment where autonomy, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving are valued.


Roadmap for Success

30 days:

  • Complete SailPoint onboarding and gain a comprehensive understanding of company culture, internal systems, and operational processes.
  • Develop foundational knowledge of SailPoint’s identity security product suite, subscription licensing models, and pricing guides.
  • Shadow team members on daily quote reviews, Salesforce CPQ workflows, and approval routing.
  • Establish working relationships with regional sales representatives, Legal/Contracts, and Finance partners.

60 days:

  • Independently manage standard quote requests and pricing exception requests for assigned EMEA territories.
  • Validate commercial terms, discounting structures, billing schedules, and partner margin requirements against established corporate guidelines.
  • Partner with the Contracts team to verify non-standard legal language and terms on generated quotes.
  • Assist sales reps with Salesforce CPQ tool navigation, troubleshooting quote configurations, and adhering to best practices.

90 days:

  • Take full ownership of Deal Desk support for designated sales teams across EMEA (including Northern EMEA and DACH regions).
  • Structure complex, multi-year subscription transactions and present non-standard approval requests to sales and finance leadership.
  • Monitor opportunity stages in Salesforce to verify quote accuracy and assist with quarterly pipeline and forecast integrity.
  • Conduct post-close audit reviews to verify contract records, SKUs, and support entitlements are accurately captured.

6 months:

  • Act as a strategic deal advisor, proactively collaborating with Account Executives and Sales Directors on high-value negotiation strategies and commercial packaging.
  • Deliver CPQ and pricing enablement sessions to onboarded sales representatives across the region.
  • Identify recurring bottlenecks in the deal cycle and recommend workflow enhancements to improve turnaround times and governance.

1 year:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on EMEA commercial strategy, complex deal mechanics, and new product introduction (NPI) rollouts.
  • Partner with global Deal Desk peers to refine global pricing policies, discounting thresholds, and CPQ system enhancements.

À propos du rôle :

Les analystes de Gartner sont des chefs de file de l’industrie qui créent des analyses incontournables, des prédictions de marché et des meilleures pratiques pour un vaste éventail d’organisations de premier plan à l’échelle mondiale. Un directeur principal agit à titre de chef de file au sein du groupe Business and Technology Insights (BTI) de Gartner, s’imposant comme une voix crédible au sein de son marché désigné aux niveaux local, régional et mondial. En s’appuyant sur des compétences exceptionnelles en recherche et en analyse, un directeur principal joue un rôle significatif dans la production d’analyses pragmatiques et stimulantes que les clients de Gartner consomment et appliquent pour propulser leur entreprise vers leurs objectifs clés. Ils constituent une source de conseils de confiance pour les clients, renforçant la valeur de Gartner au quotidien en échangeant avec eux lors de réunions en personne, de réunions virtuelles, de visites de soutien aux ventes et de conférences Gartner afin de discuter de défis complexes et d’offrir des recommandations appropriées.

Ce poste s’inscrit au sein de la pratique d’ingénierie logicielle de Gartner et conseille les dirigeants d’organisations d’ingénierie logicielle à travers le monde. L’objectif principal est d’aider les organisations à appliquer efficacement l’intelligence artificielle et les capacités agentiques tout au long du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC) ainsi que dans les logiciels qu’elles livrent afin de générer de nouvelles sources de valeur. Ce rôle fournit des conseils stratégiques sur la façon d’élaborer une stratégie globale d’IA en ingénierie logicielle, de prioriser les opportunités à haute valeur ajoutée, ainsi que de mesurer et communiquer l’impact de l’IA afin de stimuler le retour sur investissement (ROI).


Ce que vous ferez :

  • Créer du contenu innovant, stimulant la réflexion et à fort levier (« analyses incontournables »).
  • Développer de nouvelles perspectives et idées grâce au leadership éclairé et offrir des approches convaincantes et concrètes répondant aux besoins et demandes des clients afin d'accélérer leur capacité d’action.
  • Réaliser des analyses approfondies pour identifier la cause fondamentale des obstacles ou des besoins globaux d’un client, et recadrer la réflexion afin de faire avancer la stratégie.

  • Rechercher, analyser et prédire les tendances et les transformations du marché afin de fournir aux clients et aux fournisseurs des informations concrètes.
  • Fournir aux clients et prospects des conseils pratiques alignés sur leur domaine de contenu désigné, par le biais d’interactions virtuelles ou en personne.
  • Créer et présenter du matériel de présentation à haute valeur ajoutée, sur scène et hors scène, lors d’événements Gartner, de conférences d'associations sectorielles et professionnelles, et de séances d’information destinées aux clients.
  • Soutenir BTI et les ventes : Fournir un soutien aux ventes en servant de voix du marché pour aider les équipes d’analyse à créer du contenu et stimuler l’engagement auprès des clients afin qu'ils progressent vers leurs priorités stratégiques et fassent croître leur entreprise.
  • Effectuer des révisions par les pairs de contenu, de haute qualité et dans les délais impartis.
  • Renforcer sa crédibilité en tant qu'expert du secteur afin de représenter les analyses, la méthodologie et la stratégie de Gartner.
  • Participer activement aux discussions sur l’innovation, l’idéation et la recherche, et collaborer efficacement avec ses pairs de la communauté d’analyse.

  • Agir à titre de mentor et de coach en appuyant les membres plus juniors de l’équipe.
  • Adopter une approche axée sur le client tout en cherchant activement à aider les clients à faire appel régulièrement et fréquemment aux analyses et interactions de Gartner.
